rawListing.title: Scroll Emerson ZR 160 KC A************************** (free trial)

rejectionReasons: Severe specification contradiction in seller listing: Emerson ZR160KC is an industry-standard 13.3 HP / 13 TR commercial 3-phase compressor, but seller listed "2.5 ton", "Single Phase 230V", and "R32".
ZR series is designed for R22/R407C/R134a, not R32 inverter split systems.
Physical nameplate photograph must be inspected to verify whether the physical unit is a genuine 13 TR ZR160KC or a 2.5 TR residential rotary compressor mislabeled by the seller.
contradictionsDetected: OEM Rating: 13 TR (160,000 BTU/hr) 380-415V Three-Phase vs Seller Claim: 2.5 Ton 230V Single Phase.
Refrigerant: OEM R22/R407C vs Seller Claim: R32 Inverter.
